name: OP Click Buffer
description: Fixes your clicks: early ones wait, lethal ones get dropped, missed ones get clicked for you.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the assist on or off. When off, every input goes straight through.

max-input-delay.name: Max Input Delay (ticks)
max-input-delay.description:
How long one of <cy>your</c> clicks or releases is retried every tick before the mod backs off. GD runs <cy>240 ticks per second</c>, so <cy>4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS</c>.

An input that is still lethal after this keeps waiting (checked less often) and goes through the moment it is safe, or is dropped if you let go first.

rescue.name: Auto-Rescue
rescue.description: The OP part. If doing nothing would kill you within the rescue window, the mod presses, releases or taps for you at the latest moment that still survives.

rescue-window.name: Rescue Window (ticks)
rescue-window.description:
How close a death has to be before Auto-Rescue steps in. Until then you are in control.

<cy>32 ticks</c> = about 0.13 s, roughly the fastest a human can react. Bigger means the mod takes over earlier and more often; smaller keeps it to last-moment saves.

lookahead.name: Lookahead (ticks)
lookahead.description: How far ahead every prediction runs. Must be bigger than the rescue window. More = smarter but slower.

assist-ship-swing.name: Assist Ship & Swing
assist-ship-swing.description: Also correct inputs in ship and swing. These are steering modes, so corrections can feel like the ship has a mind of its own. Turn off if you prefer raw control there.

time-budget.name: Time Budget (ms)
time-budget.description: Most time one rescue search may take. One tick is about 4 ms, so anything above that can cause a tiny stutter when a rescue happens. Raise it if rescues fail on busy levels.

show-indicator.name: Show Indicator
show-indicator.description: Shows counters in the top-left corner: how many of your inputs were delayed, dropped, and how many rescues the mod did this attempt.

log-actions.name: Log Actions
log-actions.description: Writes a line to the Geode console every time the mod changes an input.
